sources.description: Author publication page for Nilim and El Ghaoui, Robust Control of Markov Decision Processes with Uncertain Transition Matrices (2005).
sources.use: Literature precedent for uncertain-transition dynamic programming; this phase is a small finite implementation.
Cryptographic verification does not itself establish the truth of the encoded claim; verifier policy and issuer evaluation remain necessary.
Identifiers and control relationships can refer to many kinds of subject; control is not a proof of personal identity or moral status.

sources.description: NIST AI Risk Management Framework page.
sources.use: Voluntary risk-management guidance; the page describes an ongoing revision and a 2026 critical-infrastructure profile concept. Adoption is not certification.
Installed CLI matches the fresh public registry observation. Release notes inform bounded retries and runtime handling; the desktop app was left to the user.
Personal marketplace registration and installed cache are separate from live hook observation.

sources.description: NVIDIA DGX Spark hardware documentation, updated September 2026.
sources.use: GB10 Grace Blackwell and 128 GB unified memory are vendor specifications, not a measured performance result on this computer.

sources.description: Google Agent Engine Memory Bank setup.
sources.use: Session storage, memory generation and runtime deployment are distinct operations with explicit IAM prerequisites. No cloud instance was created.
Managed tools, tracing, evaluations and versioned toolboxes provide architectural comparison points. No paid service was activated.
The revision discusses stateless operations, longer-running tasks and managed identity; installed endpoint support must be checked separately.

sources.description: Original Shumer post observed through the in-app browser.
sources.use: Visible scene and author report only; no independent reproduction or complete video inspection.
Author describes an Unreal world using existing assets and communicating characters. This is a prototype report and inspiration, not a capability guarantee.
Six listed problems remain unsolved; this phase does not claim any solution.
Gravitational evidence motivates an unresolved composition question; our transition uncertainty has no empirical identification with dark matter.
The cause of accelerated expansion remains a research question; historical mission dates on that page were not adopted as current schedules.

sources.description: NASA Physics of the Cosmos program.
sources.use: Gravity, extreme conditions and cosmic evolution supply research questions, not validation of project-specific tensors.
Browser recovery exposed the introduction, physical/spiritual headings and conclusion. Documentary claims remain distinct from demonstrated fits.
